spells.name: Elemental Totem
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, Shamanic Calling heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You instantly summon a small totem of your choice (see below) within range. The totem is a small object with 10 HP and armor rating 2. You and any of your allies within 10 meters of the totem gain a benefit listed below, once per round.

TotemBenefit
CleansingThe target can heal a condition of their choice at the end of their turn.
FlametongueThe target deals D4 extra damage with an attack or a spell.
StoneskinThe target takes D4 less damage from an attack or a spell.
WindfuryThe target has a boon on an attack roll.

Each additional power level lets you choose between summoning an additional totem, doubling the reach of your totem(s), or doubling your totem(s) HP and armor rating. If you cast this spell while you already have active totems, any of your previous totems disappears immediately.

spells.name: Savage Incarnation
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, Druidic Awakening heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You instantly turn into your travel form. For the duration you can change between your travel form, your humanoid form, and any other forms you have activated as an action, or as a free action if you spend 1 WP. The exact look or species of your form is up to you. While in your travel form you cannot cast any spells that have any requirements besides WORD or attack with anything other than unarmed attacks. You also don't benefit from any armor you wear in your humanoid form. Anything you are wearing transforms with you and remains on you when you turn back to your humanoid form. You can still speak while in your travel form.

You gain the following benefits while in travel form:

At power level 1, your movement rate is doubled. At power level 2, you can also breathe underwater, your movement rate in water equals your normal movement rate, and you don't have to roll for SWIMMING. At power level 3, you can also move freely through the air.

spells.name: Shadowform
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, Darkness heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You turn into a dark and shadowy image of yourself, gaining the following benefits:

  • Ethereal: All non-magical damage is halved (rounded up).
  • Shadow Weaving: The damage of your spells increases by D6 per power level.

spells.name: Feral Incarnation
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, King of the Jungle heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You instantly turn into your bear or cat form. For the duration you can change between your bear form, cat form, humanoid form, and any other forms you have activated as an action, or as a free action if you spend 1 WP. The exact look or species of your form is up to you. While in your bear or cat form you cannot cast any spells that have any requirements beside WORD or attack with anything other than unarmed attacks. You also don't benefit from any armor you wear in your humanoid form. Anything you are wearing transforms with you and remains on you when you turn back to your humanoid form. You can still speak while in your bear or cat form.

You gain the following benefits while in bear form:

  • Feral Instincts: You may roll for any SCHOOL OF MAGIC instead of BRAWLING when making unarmed attacks.
  • Ironfur: Your armor rating equals 3 per power level.
  • Maul: A creature hit by your unarmed attacks has a bane when attacking any other creature but you, until your turn in the next round.

You gain the following benefits while in cat form:

  • Feral Instincts: You may roll for any SCHOOL OF MAGIC instead of BRAWLING when making unarmed attacks.
  • Prowl: You have a boon on SNEAKING rolls.
  • Shred The damage of your unarmed attacks increases by D6 per power level.

spells.name: Incarnation of Harmony
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, Tree of Life heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You instantly turn into your tree form. For the duration you can change between your tree form, humanoid form, and any other forms you have activated as an action, or as a free action if you spend 1 WP. The exact look or species of your form is up to you. While in your tree form you cannot attack with anything other than unarmed attacks. You also don't benefit from any armor you wear in your humanoid form. Anything you are wearing transforms with you and remains on you when you turn back to your humanoid form. You can still speak while in your tree form.

You gain the following benefits while in tree form:

  • Barkskin: Your armor rating equals 2 per power level.
  • Rejuvenation: Whenever you heal a creature with a spell, that creature receives the same healing again on its next power level number of turns.

spells.name: Incarnation of the Stars
spells.prerequisite: Any School of Magic, Chosen of Elune heroic ability
spells.descriptionHtml:
You instantly turn into your moonkin form. For the duration you can change between your moonkin form, humanoid form, and any other forms you have activated as an action, or as a free action if you spend 1 WP. The exact look or species of your form is up to you. While in your moonkin form you cannot attack with anything ither than unarmed attacks. You also don't benefit from any armor you wear in your humanoid form. Anything you are wearing transforms with you and remains on you when you turn back to your humanoid form. You can still speak while in your moonkin form.

You gain the following benefits while in moonkin form:

  • Moonfire: The cost for casting spells is reduced by 1 WP per power level. This cannot decrease the cost of casting a spell below 1 WP. Magic tricks are cast for free.
  • Sunfire: Casting spells is done with a boon.

spells.name: Arcane Missiles
spells.descriptionHtml: You launch two missiles of pure arcane energy at targets within range. Each missile must target a different creature and can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. Each missile deals D4 damage, rolled separately, and armor has no effect against this damage. Each power level beyond the first launches one additional missile, which must also target a different creature. Any missile for which there is no valid target is lost.

spells.name: Arcane Blast
spells.descriptionHtml: You concentrate raw arcane energy into a single powerful blast and hurl it at a target within range. The blast can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. It deals 2D8 damage, and armor has no effect against this damage. Each power level beyond the first increases the damage by D8.

spells.name: Frost Bolt
spells.descriptionHtml: You hurl a bolt of freezing energy from your hand or focus at the target. The bolt can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. The bolt deals 2D6 damage and the target's movement rate is reduced by 4 until your turn in the next round. Each power level beyond the first increases the damage by D6 and reduces the target's movement rate by an additional 4.

spells.name: Arcane Explosion
spells.descriptionHtml: You release a violent burst of arcane energy in all directions. All creatures within the area of effect suffer 2D4 damage, and armor has no effect against this damage. Each power level beyond the first increases the range by 4 meters and the damage by D4.

spells.name: Frostfire Bolt
spells.descriptionHtml: You launch a bolt of frostfire from your hand or focus at the target. The bolt can be dodged or parried as a ranged attack. The bolt deals 2D8 damage, sets fire to flammable objects and the target's movement rate is reduced by 4 until your turn in the next round. Each power level beyond the first increases the damage by D8 and reduces the target's movement rate by an additional 4.

spells.name: Arcane Orb
spells.descriptionHtml:
You conjure an orb of concentrated arcane energy at a point within range, which then releases a burst of energy. Everyone within 2 meters of the orb takes 2D6 damage. The attack can be dodged, but not parried and armor has no effect against this damage.

At the start of each of your turns while concentrating on the spell, you may move the orb up to 6 meters. It then releases another burst of energy.

Each power level beyond the first increases the damage by D6.
